newsitem.title: UK: NSM sees sale cutting debt by 5.0 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: NSM sees sale cutting debt by 5.0 mln stg.

text.p: UK mining group NSM Plc said on Monday its sale of Clee Hill to Serial Circuit Ltd would reduce its debt by about 5.0 million stg.
NSM said it would get net payments of 1.6 million stg in cash, while Serial Circuit would assume debt obligations of 3.4 million stg.
Clee Hill had a pretax profit of 540,000 stg on turnover of 3.8 million stg for the year ended March 31.
Earlier, NSM requested suspension of trading in its shares pending clarification of its financial position.
